meta.name: github-project-contributor-finder-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users extract GitHub repository project details and contributor contact information using keywords, stars, and update dates. Agent should proactively apply this skill when users express needs like search for GitHub projects by keywords, find top open-source contributors in specific domains, extract developer contacts from GitHub repositories, discover trending repositories with high stars, gather contributor profiles and social links for tech recruiting, retrieve GitHub project descriptions and metrics, build developer communities by finding active contributors, search for repositories updated recently, collect personal website and Twitter links of developers, generate targeted leads for developer tools, or track active open-source contributors for collaboration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按关键词和星数搜索GitHub项目并获取贡献者联系方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从GitHub发现项目并联系贡献者
copy.tagline_en: Search GitHub projects by keywords and stars, get contributor contacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover GitHub projects and contact contributors

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的关键词、最低星数和更新日期，自动搜索 GitHub 仓库，并提取仓库详情和贡献者的联系方式（如个人网站、Twitter）。
howto.when: 当你提出搜索 GitHub 项目、查找特定领域的开源贡献者、获取开发者联系方式等需求时，Claude 会自动触发该技能。

say.text: 帮我找最近更新的、星数超过100的机器学习项目。
say.note: Claude 会调用技能搜索并返回项目列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search GitHub repositories based on keywords, minimum stars, and update date, then extract repository details and contributor contact info (e.g., personal website, Twitter).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search GitHub projects, find open-source contributors in specific domains, or get developer contact info.

say_en.text: Find recently updated machine learning projects with over 100 stars.
say_en.note: Claude will search and return project list.

say_en.text: Search for 'react framework' with at least 500 stars, updated after 2025.
say_en.note: Claude will filter and extract repo and contributor info.
